## Game calls the 0.695 UI makes that 0.589's doesn't (ActionScript → client)

| Call | From | Feature (→ client packet, channels-695.tsv) |
|---|---|---|
| `Claims.SetClaimAdventureFlag` | BuildModeTimeWidget (Advanced Build Settings) | Play Mode Rules → ClaimsPacketSetAdventureFlags |
| `Claims.StartClaimPlacement` | ClaimManagementWindow | place a build site from the window → ClaimsPacketStartClaimPlacement |
| `Templates.RequestPurchaseTemplateMaterialsData`, `Templates.PurchaseMissingTemplateMaterials`, `BuyResourcesButton` | SelectedTemplate, TemplateConfirmationWidget | buy a Design's missing materials → TemplatePacketPurchaseTemplateMaterialsDataRequest / PurchaseMissingTemplateMaterials |
| `Ui.SetBio` | Inventory | Bio → PlayerUpdatePacketSetPlayerBio (0x26 / 0x80) |
| `InstancedGame.SwitchTeam` | ClaimWalkOnTextWindow | Game Table team switching → InstancedGameRequestJoinTeamPacket |
| `RulesetObject.UpdateValueBool / Float / String`, `UpdateDirtySliders` | RulesetObjectSettings | the reworked Game Table settings |
| `Mesh.PlaceMesh / SelectMesh / SelectCategory / SearchPalette / FilterMeshesByAvailability` | BuildModeWidget, MeshesWindow | Mesh Shapes tab (client palette; what reaches the server: trace) |
| `HudStateManager:OnToggle/OnClose{Designs, Materials, Meshes, Props, Shortcuts, Tints, Tools}` | BuildModeWidget, the modular windows | modular build mode (client only) |
| `HudStateManager:OnOpenCharacterInventory` | BarberShopWidget | Parlor → inventory |

Still to trace: the Lua / native side of each call down to its packet (0.695 luabind), and the Inspect window's
data source (InspectWidget has no new game calls of its own).
